mintAuthority.summary: GBPA has five issuer-native deployments. Ethereum, Base and Arc retain a direct EOA fiat minter and an EOA owner of upgrade administration; Arc's complete explorer role-grant/revoke inventory is now corroborated by pinned state. Tempo retains the same minter and sole role/cap administrator, while its token-bound transfer proxy still lacks deployed-executable closure. TIP-403 policy 552 uses built-in always-allow mint-recipient policy 1, separately from its sender blacklist. Solana uses a 1-of-2 Token-2022 multisig; LayerZero program and transfer controls remain separately reviewed under Bridge Risk.
mintAuthority.headline: Issuer keys can mint and replace issuance logic; monthly reserve reconciliation does not impose an on-chain backing constraint.

controls.evidence: October 15 pinned reads at Ethereum 26197414, Base 52635993 and Arc 26080855 return hasMintRole=true for this address and eth_getCode=0x on all three chains. Each explorer's complete four-topic MintRoleGranted/MintRoleRevoked/AdminRoleGranted/AdminRoleRevoked inventory terminates with next_page_params=null: one fiat-minter grant, one administrator grant and no revocations. Verified implementations allow nominal role-controlled minting without a reserve oracle or numeric native issuance cap. Arc's implementation address differs because its immutable endpoint differs; its separately verified AgantTokenUpgradeable source has the same native mint authorization.

EIP-1967 implementation/admin slots retain 0x4b55cc51901ef212a6cb4fa5e5daa6575afdd3f0 on Ethereum/Base, 0x302a8a24e79c4f987cb7dd4993a8c998079784b1 on Arc, and ProxyAdmin 0x2ebc550927191e2ef13cedbcf2886dcd810dabc9 on each chain. Bridge peer/configuration powers are recorded separately.

controls.evidence: The complete genesis-to-block-44247678 token log census identifies this as the sole DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE member, granted at creation; pinned membership is true and eth_getCode is empty. TIP-20 permits this administrator to grant ISSUER_ROLE, change its admin role, change supplyCap and replace the token transfer policy. Policy 552 remains COMPOUND with immutable sender/recipient/mint-recipient references (551,1,1), not an unexplained zero-admin controller. Policy 551 is a mutable BLACKLIST administered by 0x5c32ec946062109c61260c738e2fd794b18499d8; built-in policy 1 always allows recipients. No independent native issuance bound or timelock is established.

review.evidence: October 15 independently refreshes all five deployments. Ethereum/Base/Arc complete explorer grant/revoke inventories and pinned current memberships retain sole fiat minter 0x5c32ec946062109c61260c738e2fd794b18499d8 and role administrator/owner 0xbecf04e2348d00885c62d97d9629c99e581fe00f. The latter can authorize new native minters without first upgrading. Tempo's complete block-bounded 22-log token census and current hasRole reads retain two issuers, the fiat minter and token-bound transfer proxy, plus the sole default administrator. Policy 552's (551,1,1) compound references and policy 551's blacklist administrator are freshly pinned. Exact same-slot Solana archived account reads retain the 1-of-2 native mint multisig, permanent delegate and separate live OFT program upgrade wallet. June-September reports are publicly indexed; August and September reports were reopened and support periodic whole-supply month-end reconciliation and independent attestation, not continuous reconciliation or prudential oversight. Financial assurance disclaimers remain contradictory. Current state reads do not extend the independently curated finite incident-history windows or certify complete executable closure.
unresolvedQuestions: What is the exact executable native mint reach and upgrade/authorization closure of Tempo transfer proxy 0x5575151bf6076129d0729c0f40d967d41df34a63? October 15 block 44247678 retains implementation 0x57d51739b3c73bc38819556835a9a6e14474e782, ProxyAdmin 0x1703d87af0893964c1effef756ee20424b75530e and adapter/admin owner 0xbecf04e2348d00885c62d97d9629c99e581fe00f. The 10727-byte runtime SHA-256 remains a1dd9b368b81b963b744a12bf32e0200d00c846b0822115da8967df6feaf178c. Exact metadata CID QmZj1as9t5SKSYUNgqKXsDt9BJZNRcWFHn59mGzsQAfToR remains unavailable: Sourcify full/partial/v2 lookups return 404, ipfs.io and dweb.link return 429, Pinata times out and Filebase returns 504. These are source-availability blockers, not proof of issuer nondisclosure. Known owners, endpoint, peers and DVNs do not establish exact executable mint authorization or complete replacement/bypass closure.
